reviewScope: Independent editorial review of localized titles, summaries, section hierarchy and newly authored feature overviews; source-section comparison for retained procedural meaning across every guide.
source: Original locale corpus captured in /tmp/minddy-mega-articles/content/documentation; migration mapping content/documentation/legacy-routes.json.
actualChecks: Read the complete title, summary and heading inventories for both locales. Reviewed all newly authored overviews and summary changes against source procedures and localized terminology.

Compared all 225 original section bodies per locale with their mapped destination. Only the listed body edits differ after normalizing whitespace and Markdown link destinations; headings are compared by IDs/order separately.
Checked every original section ID through its legacy mapping and preserved relative section order. No added section IDs or reordered procedures.

Compared all original fenced executable examples byte-for-byte and all inherited figure manifests including caption, alt text, source, capture date and review flags, allowing only the guide revision increment.

Read the retained page publication/export/import, database schema/import, Numo authorization/recovery, project membership, Git synchronization, notification/offline and operational warning passages to substantiate new scope statements.

Confirmed Portuguese UI terminology in messages/pt-BR.json: Issue.entity=Problema and Issue.entityPlural=Problemas. Generic guide title and new issue references use this terminology; the guide opening explicitly explains the retained issue synonym.
Confirmed duplicate installation warnings retain their complete first occurrence and a linked, scope-specific reminder at the second occurrence, with applicable warnings still before commands.
changes: Added localized overview paragraphs to all 19 multi-source feature guides per locale; retained procedure entry points, access boundaries, profiles and recovery qualifications.
Rewrote incomplete or imperative-inconsistent summaries for operational and single-feature guides. Clarified PWA installation and the absence of a generic page import action.
Improved localized headings without changing their IDs/order, including persistent Numo turns, backup completion, authentication email setup and page export/database archive import.
Changed newly authored Portuguese Tickets titles/references to Problemas in accordance with actual UI labels; retained literal API/tool identifiers and prior source terminology.
Replaced two duplicated installation warning paragraphs per locale with same-page cross-references and a direct applicable warning, keeping all original warning facts in the first occurrence.
Repaired the Italian first-project Smart Fill sentence subject, the Portuguese grammatical gender of console in instance administration and the Portuguese explicit read-only doctor description.
limits: No new installation, backup, restoration, application mutation or browser procedure was executed by this reviewer. Existing procedural evidence and screenshot captures remain inherited from their original review.
No human native-speaker review or new screenshot capture is claimed. Source comparison verifies retention, not current release behavior.
Parent agent owns complete documentation, lint, tests, browser validation and pull-request publication.
revisionFinalization: Parent raised current guide, English source and figure revisions above the highest inherited revision in every locale. Article wording was unchanged by this metadata correction; this record identifies the resulting guide revisions.
